title: Approved incident response plan and playbooks
description: Versioned, approved incident response plan with severity model, roles, playbooks (unauthorized grant or payment instruction, tenant data exposure, compromised AI agent, compromised build pipeline, ransomware, credential compromise), regulatory notification matrix and annual review record.

title: Incident roles, on-call roster and external retainer record
description: Named incident commander and deputies, on-call schedule, escalation tree, customer contact registry with verification dates, and retained outside counsel and forensic firm (or the absence of each).

title: Exercise record
description: Tabletop and technical exercise records: date, scenario, participants, timings for key actions (log retrieval, account disablement, payment hold, key rotation), gaps found and corrective action status.
notes: SOC2-015 requires dated evidence of incident response tabletop exercises.

title: Incident timeline and notification log
description: Per incident: detection, determination, containment, eradication and recovery timestamps; each notification sent (recipient, legal basis or contract clause, deadline, time sent, content hash, channel, acknowledgment).

title: Regulatory notification obligation matrix
description: Machine-readable matrix of notification obligations by customer type and jurisdiction (CIRN rule bank service provider notice, Regulation S-P service provider notice, state breach laws, NYDFS 500.17 support, GDPR Article 33 processor notice, contractual terms), with deadlines, triggers, recipients and contact sources, reviewed by counsel.

title: Forensic evidence preservation and chain of custody record
description: Preserved artifacts (logs, snapshots, images, agent ledgers) with hashes, custody transfers, storage location, access log and retention or legal hold status.

title: Post-incident report and corrective action tracker
description: Root cause analysis, contributing factors, customer-facing summary, corrective actions with owners and due dates, and verification that threats, invariants, tests and detections were updated.

title: Ransomware readiness evidence
description: Immutable or logically isolated backup configuration, restore test results with timing, and the approved ransom payment decision policy including sanctions screening steps.

title: Containment action record
description: Each containment action (credential revocation, tenant isolation, platform hold, agent kill switch) with authority, scope, timing, sponsor notification and release.
